description: Build GTM plays, multi-provider data enrichment workflows, and automated outbound systems using an AI-powered sales platform.
auth_notes: API keys can be found and managed in workspace settings to authenticate API requests.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free plan self-serve which includes free actions/credits and API key access.
api_notes: Provides API and CLI capabilities for building in Clay directly via coding agents, alongside webhook integrations on higher tiers.
mcp_notes: Clay officially publishes the Clay MCP for Reps ("agent-plugins") to search, enrich, and reach out to leads from AI chat tools.
rationale: Clay provides public developer access via self-serve free accounts, API/CLI tooling, and an official MCP server for agent integration.

evidence.note: Documentation covering how to find your Clay API key for authentication.
